dedupe_keys.name: new york fed balance sheets and income statements of commercial banks 1959 2025

description: A long, harmonised panel of US commercial bank financial statements. The New York Fed page says the dataset holds time-consistent balance sheet and income statement variables from 1959 to 2025, built from more than 2.5 million quarterly Call Reports of 24,000 unique banks collected by the FFIEC, with a subset of more granular line items, bank identifiers, bank location and links to bank holding companies, and that it was used in Correia, Luck and Verner (2026). The balance sheet and income statement files, a data dictionary and documentation are free downloads with a suggested citation. Coverage is United States commercial banks. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read, and variables are harmonised, so they differ from the raw filings. For simulation it supports long-run studies of bank failures and lending after regional shocks, including disasters, with bank locations for exposure mapping. A related catalogue record is the FFIEC Call Report bulk data.
